ruleset_status: Forsaken Depths Heroic Spell Table (FD p.19, roll d6) — scrolls, inscriptions, Cyclopean Idol bas-relief, and cast resolver.

spells.name: Boatman's Luck
spells.summary: Cast on a boat: skip first river hazard, +Tier in first river fight, fireproof through Flame river. Druids may learn.

spells.name: Eldritch Fist
spells.summary: Illusionary giant hand: withdraw, strike, knock door, lift, or grab a foe (+Tier melee vs held target until another spell).

spells.name: Mass Blessing
spells.summary: Blessing on all party, companions, and hirelings; caster loses 1 Life per extra target and per extra condition removed.

spells.name: Fire of Truth
spells.summary: Fireball vs living only; +1 vs chaos; Save vs target L (+L) for 1 Clue; natural 1 triggers wandering monsters.

spells.name: Teleport Enemy
spells.summary: Spell roll vs one foe's Level teleports it d6 visited rooms away; it may not return if blocked.

spells.name: Mass Invisibility
spells.summary: Illusion vs one foe's L: party unseen until they attack; rogue may Stealth-steal one item or L×10 gp.
